title: Chartered Accountant
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT (CA) Job Title: Chartered Accountant (CA) 
 Department: Finance & Accounts 
 Reporting To: CFO / Finance Head / Director – Finance 
 Location: Kolkata 
 Experience: 3–8 years post-qualification experience 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Role Overview We are looking for a qualified and experienced Chartered Accountant (CA) to take ownership of key Finance & Accounts functions, including financial reporting, accounting controls, taxation, statutory compliance, treasury, audit coordination, reconciliations and management reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Indian accounting standards, GST, TDS, direct taxation, financial controls, audit, banking and MIS , along with hands-on experience in Tally/ERP and advanced Excel . The role will work closely with senior management and business teams to ensure financial accuracy, regulatory compliance, effective cash-flow management and timely decision-making. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Accounting & Controls Oversee day-to-day accounting and ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions. Review and approve accounting entries, provisions, accruals, journal entries and ledger balances. Ensure proper accounting of revenue, expenses, credit notes, debit notes, rebates, claims, wastage and other commercial adjustments. Conduct regular bank, customer, supplier and inter-company reconciliations . Review depot/site-wise stock and inventory reconciliation and investigate variances. Establish and strengthen internal financial controls and accounting processes. Ensure proper maintenance of books of accounts and supporting documentation. 2. Statutory Compliance & Taxation Ensure timely and accurate compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, Professional Tax and other applicable statutory requirements . Review GST returns, reconciliations, input tax credit and related documentation. Review TDS deductions, returns, certificates and related reconciliations. Coordinate with external tax consultants and advisors on taxation matters. Monitor changes in applicable tax laws and assess their impact on business operations. Ensure timely payment of statutory dues and filing of statutory returns. 3. Financial Reporting & MIS Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and management reports. Prepare P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and other financial analysis for management review. Develop and monitor financial MIS, business dashboards and variance reports. Analyse actual performance against budget, forecast and previous periods. Highlight significant financial variances, risks and exceptions to management. Provide financial insights and analysis to support management decision-making. 4. Audit & Compliance Management Coordinate statutory, internal, tax and other audits . Job Description 
 We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Professional with strong expertise in Lightning Flows, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Apex to design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions. The ideal candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and administrators to deliver highquality, secure, and performance applications on the Salesforce platform.

 Salesforce Development Design and implement custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, LWC, and declarative tools Build and maintain Lightning Flows (Screen, RecordTriggered, Scheduled, Autolaunched) to automate business processes Develop reusable and performant Lightning Web Components (LWC) following Salesforce best practices Create and maintain Apex classes, triggers, and test classes with required code coverage
